title: 20s Charleston Dance Tutorial - Full Choreography to the Song "Black Bottom"

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down choreography step by step while facing the camera or turning away for demonstration. She uses verbal counting and explains musicality concepts like off-beat rhythms.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Black Bottom choreography tutorial
Explaining the structure of the song into three parts: AABA, solo part, and AABA
Breaking down Part 1 - AABA, starting with the first A section

steps_taught.name: Slapping move / Slaps
steps_taught.description: Off-beat slap movements with arms and legs

what_works: Clear division of the song structure
Demonstrating from the back so students can follow along easily

quotes.text: I'm going to show you the breakdown to my Charleston twenties choreography
We will divide the song into three different parts
What is that? It's called the offbeat.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates Charleston basic steps facing away from the camera
Teacher demonstrates hip bounces facing away from camera
Teacher shows side view of slap movements

extraction.distinctive_method: Structuring the dance practice around musical phrasing (AABA) and explicitly teaching off-beat clapping/slapping.
